# Sorane (空音) - LLMS Context
This file provides context for AI agents reading the Sorane project documentation.

## Core Concepts
- Typography-First SSG: Precision rendering with Zero Layout Shift.
- Web/A: Archival-grade Web format (Portable, Verifiable, Machine-Readable).
- Post-Quantum Cryptography: ML-DSA-44 and ML-KEM-768 for long-term security.
- Human-Machine Parity (HMP): Documents are equally readable for humans and agents.
